missingValueRule: missing, unknown, declined, stale or unavailable values are never materialized as false, zero or negative answers
modifierOwnershipRule: modifier bindings must point to authorized canonical owner projections; onboarding hints are not promoted to medical source of truth
fallback: PERIOD_FALLBACK_REQUIRED when no authoritative lifecycle or temporal semantic is present
observability: metadata only; no user id, canonical values, answers or health content
